card.name: Small words before risk or deficit phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words ("the", "been", "those") that come right before a risk, harm or deficit phrase. Seen after "To minimize" and "are" in risk statements.

modes.label: After "To minimize"
modes.description: The word "the" after "To minimize", before a risk phrase.
modes.example: To minimize<< the>> potential risk for an adverse CV event in

modes.label: Those with impairment
modes.description: The word "those" after a statement of who is at greatest risk, before a list of conditions.
modes.example: Patients at greatest risk of this reaction are<< those>> with impaired renal function, dehydration, hyp

modes.label: Been before deceived
modes.description: The word "been" in a passive verb phrase describing victims of harm.
modes.example: honest workers who have<< been>> deceived by corrupt Jewish leaders and betrayed by

card.writes: It seems to steer the next words away from "lack" and "lacking" type words, toward phrases like "借助" and "配备了".
card.plain: It fires on little words like "the" or "those" just before a phrase about risk or who is affected.
